correctness.rationale: A two-step shift has disjoint outgoing supports for different origins, so its commutator is diagonal-minus-rank-one on each two-step child set, with nonnegative uncoupled root entries. Write s=sum |b_j|² and X_j=|d_{j,1}|². The one-step block at the fork gives sum |b_j|²/X_j≤1, with b_j=0 when X_j=0. Monotone ray weights make the fork's grandchild block and later ray blocks positive semidefinite. For the stem block entering the fork, Cauchy–Schwarz gives ||S²e_u||²=sum |b_j|²X_j≥s², dominating the squared incoming two-step stem weight; the preceding stem junction follows from |a|²≤s and stem monotonicity. Thus a root fork has zero defect, and when there is a parent only the first-ray-vertex block can be negative. It is bounded below by diag(X_j²)-sbb*. Normalizing the quotients |b_j|²/X_j to a probability measure, with total mass μ≤1 and mean ρ, the affine majorant for x/(x²+δ) implies s sum |b_j|²/(X_j²+δ)≤μ²[2ρ/σ−(ρ/σ)²]≤1. The factorization is confirmed by coefficient matching: 2σ=1+2α, 2σδ=α², δ+σ²=2α+α². With masses q=(1−σ)/(1−α) at α and 1−q at 1, both inequalities are equalities; constant ray weights sqrt(X_j) and stem weights sqrt(σ) are admissible at norm one. The kernel vector b_j/(X_j²+δ) belongs to l² even for countably many rays since δ>0. Scaling changes the commutator by the fourth power of the norm. Replay square_order_bound() in /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py checks the scalar coefficients and the two-dimensional exact sharpness determinants; the countable operator proof does not rely on finite checks.

value.rationale: The smallest branching geometry where squaring can break hyponormality is a motivated setting for quantifying failure, not just finding an example. The best bound and two-level positive-weight attainment show exactly how large an error a normalized square can incur even with arbitrarily many rays. The scalar argument is also informative beyond this setup: for 0≤A≤B≤I and any x with <x,Ax>>0, the rank-one compression R_x=(Ax)(Ax)*/<x,Ax> obeys R_x≤A and R_x x=Ax. Writing R_x=ξξ* with ξ=B^(1/2)η, ||η||≤1, the same affine majorant by functional calculus bounds ||ξ||²<ξ,(B²+δI)^(-1)ξ> by one. Thus the mechanism controls the broader order defect too; this ancillary observation is not a separate priority claim.
